pkgmetadata.longdescription: Rapid-MLX is a high-performance OpenAI-compatible inference server built on Apple MLX. It provides sub-100ms cached time-to-first-token, full tool calling support with 17 parser backends, prompt caching, reasoning separation, and cloud routing. Serves as a drop-in replacement for the OpenAI API and is compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and Aider.
